element_fields.description_en:
The device name that must be provided when validating imported GB/T 32960 protocol cloud gateway devices.  

The device name supports English letters and digits, with a length of 4 to 17 characters.  

> A single API invocation can include up to 10,000 device names. Data exceeding this limit will be discarded.
element_fields.description_zh:
校验导入的GB/T 32960协议云网关设备时，需传入的设备名称。

设备名称支持英文字母和数字，长度限制为4~17个字符。

> 单次调用该接口，最多能传入10,000个设备名称。超过该限制的数据会被丢弃。
